gates.failure_action: stop: a frame from an unidentified configuration cannot enter a run
gates.host_method: match the boot line `#CG LOG v=.. fw=.. hw=.. device=.. pin_map=..` against the frozen as-built record for the campaign
gates.note: committed evidence carries hw=CG-HW-001, pin_map=2, fw=cg-w04-0.1.0
gates.requirement: hardware config

gates.failure_action: stop: opening the port resets the board, so a boot_id first seen mid-capture means the early frames belong to another boot
gates.host_method: open the capture before ARM so the boot line is inside the file
gates.note: the probe-identification session changed boot_id per touch window for exactly this reason
gates.requirement: one boot_id per run, recorded before the run starts

gates.doc_anchor: docs/05A §18 A-W09-01; docs/01 §19.3 (unknown DS18B20 identity is INVALID)
gates.failure_action: stop: a probe whose identity is unknown cannot drive a derived state
gates.host_method: ROM ids come from the per-boot `#CG ROM role=.. rom=.. present=..` lines, not from the frame; the frame carries slot roles only
gates.note: PARTIAL because the H8S frame has no ROM field. The slot->position mapping is OPERATOR-FROZEN (T1 centre, T2 TEC hot side, T3 bottom, T4 near door) and is recorded *by-source* from the firmware ROM table; it is not verified by readback
gates.requirement: sensor identity

gates.doc_anchor: docs/05A §18 A-W09-03 (sensor moved invalidates a run)
gates.failure_action: invalidate the run; a moved probe is a physical invalidation
gates.host_method: operator visual confirmation against the frozen geometry record; the 2026-11-02 PROBE_IDENTIFICATION session is the identity record but must never be reused as thermal data
gates.note: the device cannot see its own probes being moved; slot roles stay ROLE_ASSIGNED_PHYSICAL_LABEL_PENDING in the boot line
gates.requirement: each probe is physically where the frozen geometry says it is

gates.doc_anchor: docs/05A §18 A-W09-01; docs/01 §19.3 (wrong PZEM range is INVALID)
gates.failure_action: stop: an unqualified electrical column makes the run's energy and active-range claims unusable
gates.host_method: confirm the PZEM configuration and the limit table the boot line echoes
gates.note: PARTIAL: the frame reports a status per electrical field and the approved limit policy, but not the instrument's configured range. The committed CSV carries voltage_status/current_status EMPTY in all 957 rows, which is exactly the failure this gate exists to catch
gates.requirement: PZEM range

gates.failure_action: stop: a run without a valid initial condition has no baseline to differ from
gates.host_method: record the first VALID frame as the run's initial condition
gates.note: docs/03 §5 wants target_state, tmean_c, tmax_c, gradient_c and door state here
gates.requirement: initial state

gates.doc_anchor: docs/05A §18 A-W09-01; docs/03 §5 (initial_condition.door: CLOSED); docs/05A §19 A-W10-02
gates.failure_action: do not start: door_open=UNKNOWN is not CLOSED. A polarity confirmation only makes the level nameable, it does not prove the magnet reaches the switch
gates.host_method: operator confirms the lid is seated; MC-38 polarity is confirmed per boot with `DOOR NEAR_LOW|NEAR_HIGH <token>`
gates.note: the strongest available statement is sensor level + confirmed polarity. The 2026-11-01 MC-38 work documents a stuck-high input that `DOOR NEAR_HIGH` made the firmware echo as CLOSED (door_open=0, snapshot=VALID), which is why this gate stays PARTIAL rather than OBSERVABLE
gates.requirement: door closed at rest, with a machine-readable state

gates.failure_action: stop: an unknown output posture is a safety posture change
gates.host_method: read the `#CG H8 ACTUATOR` and BOOT_POLICY lines
gates.note: committed H8 frames report supervised_bench=1 with supervised_authorized=0
gates.requirement: the actuator gate and interlock posture are known before ARM

gates.failure_action: stop: a run with no raw file is not evidence-grade and cannot be replayed
gates.host_method: the capture host confirms the file is open and growing, and that rejections are being written beside samples rather than dropped
gates.note: the device has no non-volatile run storage; `cloud=NOT_PROVISIONED` in every frame and there is no transport in this firmware
gates.requirement: storage online (capture is actually being written)

gates.failure_action: record as a validity finding; a gap invalidates the affected interval, not necessarily the run
gates.host_method: gap statistics on the host clock, e.g. the W05 timing pilot method
gates.note: device_ms is per-boot uptime; the host clock owns the cadence claim
gates.requirement: the declared cadence is met (1 Hz nominal) and gaps are counted

gates.doc_anchor: docs/05A §17 pass criteria (safe physical envelope); docs/04 §5.2
gates.failure_action: stop the stage
gates.host_method: operator attestation in the run manifest
gates.note: supervised_bench is a compile-time posture, not a live human-presence sensor
gates.requirement: an operator is at the bench for the whole energized run

gates.failure_action: record; an unexplained end reason makes the run a validity candidate only after review
gates.host_method: confirm the last frame's stop_reason is consistent with how the stage ended
gates.note: the committed 600 s capture ends with stop_reason=STAGE_DEADLINE on 131 rows
gates.requirement: end reason

gates.failure_action: invalidate the run physically (A-W09-03) and keep the raw attempt
gates.host_method: the control file (commands actually sent) plus the operator's note; the device cannot see a hand on a probe or a magnet near a sensor
gates.note: this is the gate the 2026-11-02 touch-identification session fails by design: every frame there has a hand on a probe, which is why it is excluded from S1/S2/S4
gates.requirement: manual intervention logged

gates.failure_action: record; unexplained anomalies escalate to the campaign owner
gates.host_method: operator observation plus host-side validity analysis
gates.note: fault_bits is a device-side vocabulary; a thermal excursion with no fault bit is invisible to the device
gates.requirement: anomaly recorded

gates.doc_anchor: docs/05A §18 A-W09-03; docs/03 §6 run lifecycle (COMPLETED_RAW -> VALIDITY_REVIEW)
gates.failure_action: no valid S1 ID is issued; the attempt stays in the registry
gates.host_method: cg_w09_validity.evaluate_frames() over the raw capture; the producer's snapshot flag is a first pass, not the verdict
gates.note: never delete an invalid attempt (A-W09-03)
gates.requirement: validity candidate assigned

gates.failure_action: the export is not published
gates.host_method: SHA-256 of each source recorded in the export and in SHA256SUMS.txt
gates.note: a dataset whose bytes are not pinned cannot be re-derived later
gates.requirement: every ingested source file is hash-pinned

gates.failure_action: reject the frames; PROBE_IDENTIFICATION may never enter S1/S2/S4
gates.host_method: cg_w09_validity rejects frames whose run label is an excluded class
gates.note: enforced by label match, not by inspecting temperatures, so it cannot be defeated by a plausible-looking touch window
gates.requirement: the run's session class is eligible for the dataset it is entering

gates.failure_action: the export raises instead of writing
gates.host_method: every export refuses a source whose provenance has is_physical_measurement=false
gates.note: validated by validate_w09.py and by the W09/W10/W11 unit tests
gates.requirement: a host fixture can never be published as a run

gates.failure_action: the disturbance is not an S2 pilot event; record it as an incidental door observation instead
gates.host_method: MC-38 transition as machine ground truth plus the operator timer as a secondary check
gates.note: an incidental OPEN window inside a commissioning stage is not a protocolised disturbance and is not counted as one
gates.requirement: for S2, the disturbance was operator-controlled and timed

gates.failure_action: reject the trace
gates.host_method: cg_w11_s4 refuses a trace that infers applied evidence from intent
gates.note: applied state must be read from the device, not from what was requested
gates.requirement: for S4, a refused command never appears as an applied action

honesty_notes: a gate is OBSERVABLE only when a shipped frame field decides it
door polarity confirmation names a level; it does not prove a physical door position
firmware has no run storage and no transport: storage and command issuance are host/operator gates by construction
an invalid attempt is recorded, never deleted (docs/05A §18 A-W09-03)
